desc:
🖤 Welcome to Be Venom for Animals!

How to Play

🚀 Launch your Venom head as far as you can

🦁 Take over animals in different areas and add them to your collection

🧬 EVOLVE into cooler Venom Forms with different abilities!

💰 Earn money from the animals you collect

🧪 Buy stronger toxins to take over bigger, rarer animals

🔊 Train your Venom with sound waves from speakers to boost your Launch Power

🌍 Launch farther to unlock new areas with bigger, stronger, and rarer animals
